purpose: Gate the next skeleton-first Blender revision. A region is READY only when its geometry targets, measurement semantics and hard invariants are sufficiently defined to instantiate without relying on the r95 mesh.
rules: READY means geometry can be instantiated from anatomy evidence without preserving the old mesh by default.
PARTIAL means some anchors are defensible but remaining geometry could still materially alter movement or proportions.
BLOCKED means at least one essential dimension/contact/axis is still undefined or source-incompatible.
No region becomes READY solely because an existing a003 dimension is plausible.

gate_rule: Do not create a new canonical Blender audit revision while any region is BLOCKED unless the revision is explicitly partial/non-acceptance and cannot be mistaken for the next canonical candidate.

owner_decisions.decision: The canonical skeleton is anatomically accurate for a standard 1.82 m adult male. The body mesh is refitted to the skeleton afterwards.
consequences: The r95/a003 authored forearm-hand shortness, long feet and broad shoulders are not intended styling and must not constrain canonical bone lengths.
Agreement with the r95 surface is no longer sufficient corroboration for a canonical bone length; targets come from stature-conditioned anatomical evidence with matched endpoint definitions.
This answers the F-PROP-001 owner question. It does not select any numeric target or change freeze_ready.
owner_decisions.skeleton_precedence: Once a skeleton element is confirmed anatomically correct, it is never changed to suit the mesh. The mesh, weights and deformation are adapted to the skeleton. A confirmed element may change only on new anatomical evidence, never on mesh fit.
